Resource ID of the existing storage account deployment scripts will use. Must be in the same subscription as "csInfraSubscriptionId", since deployment scripts only support an existing storage account from their own subscription.

Access key for the existing storage account. Required unless "subnetId" is set - Azure Container Instances can mount an existing storage account without a key when the deployment script runs inside a virtual network and its identity has the Storage File Data Privileged Contributor role (granted automatically).

Resource ID of a subnet (delegated to Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups) the deployment script container will run in. Required only if the storage account is not reachable from a public or service-endpoint-allowed network path.
